instruction:
Nursery Cluster Issue Set with Occupancy Schedule

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as result.txt, result.ifc, result.pdf. Export result.txt as a tab-delimited occupancy schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey entity and exactly 8 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 1 IfcSlab entity, and at least 1 IfcRoof entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: CLASSROOM-1, CLASSROOM-2, CLASSROOM-3, COMMON, SLEEP, STAFF, WC-CHILD, WC-STAFF.
7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, -0.3] and max [15.0, 17.0, 4.35].
9. result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: ZoneName, Area, Storey.
10. result.txt has exactly 8 data rows in this order: CLASSROOM-1 20.0 GROUND, CLASSROOM-2 20.0 GROUND, CLASSROOM-3 20.0 GROUND, COMMON 36.0 GROUND, SLEEP 16.0 GROUND, STAFF 9.0 GROUND, WC-CHILD 9.0 GROUND, WC-STAFF 7.5 GROUND, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10.
11. result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A131, PLAN, SECTION, NURSERY CLUSTER WITH OCCUPANCY SCHEDULE, CLASSROOM-1, COMMON, SLEEP, WC-STAFF.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
